scope: Proposition 19.5 (Rough-interior moment transfer) of the manuscript “Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces” (preprints/Conformal-Limits-of-Critical-Square-Lattice-Random-Cluster-Interfaces-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b14b09c2088272ae), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 117. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Condition on exterior pocket data converging to a containing contour as in Lemma 19.4. At every fixed distinct tuple of points in U, the joint moments of the residual zero-offset height converge to the Wick moments of independent fields σΦ0 Ω in the components Ω of U. This holds along every such convergent sequence of exterior data. Several containing contours at one generation may be treated simultaneously, taking the product over them.
